modules.title: API 代理如何完成一次模型调用
为什么中转站有隐私风险

items.title: 请求和返回都会经过中转站
items.text: 请求中的提示词、上下文、文件片段，以及可能随请求发送的凭证，会先到达中转站；Provider 返回的内容也会经过中转站后再到工具。

items.title: 公开信息只让服务更容易核验
items.text: 有公开运营主体、官方文档和服务条款的平台，更容易检查服务边界、计费和隐私政策，但这不等于它天然可信。只要请求经过第三方，就要继续核对数据留存、密钥处理和上游服务。

items.title: 来源不明的服务风险更高
items.text: 有些非正规中转站可能通过号池、反向代理等方式拼接调用资源；如果它记录请求、篡改返回或注入内容，AI 工具通常无法替你审核它的数据处理行为。因此不要把密钥、源码和敏感业务数据交给来源不明的中转站。

modules.title: 中转站不是模型 Provider
modules.text: API 代理通常只负责接收、转发和返回数据，不等于它自己训练或运行模型；本地 VPN 或网络代理也不一定理解 API 协议。换了地址只能改变网络路径，不能自动保证匿名、安全、结果质量或上游可用性。

lessonPractice.title: 一次模型调用经过 API 代理时，正确的请求和返回链路是？

options.label: 个人通过 AI 工具发起请求 → 中转站 → 模型提供商 → 中转站 → 返回给个人
options.feedback: 对。请求先从个人经 AI 工具发给中转站，再由中转站转给模型提供商；结果也要经过中转站返回个人，所以两段内容都经过中转站。

options.label: 个人通过 AI 工具发起请求 → 模型提供商 → 中转站 → 返回给个人
options.feedback: 不对。这个链路跳过了中转站接收请求的环节；如果配置了 API 代理，请求应先到中转站，再由它转给模型提供商。

options.label: 个人通过 AI 工具发起请求 → 中转站，中转站直接生成模型结果
options.feedback: 不对。中转站只负责接收、转发和返回数据，真正运行模型并生成结果的是模型提供商。

en.title: What is the correct request-and-response path through an API proxy?

options.label: You send a request through the AI tool → proxy relay → model provider → proxy relay → back to you
options.feedback: Correct. The request goes from you through the AI tool to the relay and then to the model provider; the result also passes through the relay on its way back to you.

options.label: You send a request through the AI tool → model provider → proxy relay → back to you
options.feedback: Not quite. This path skips the relay when the request is sent. With an API proxy configured, the request should reach the relay first, which forwards it to the model provider.

options.label: You send a request through the AI tool → proxy relay, and the relay generates the model result
options.feedback: Not quite. The relay receives, forwards, and returns data; the model provider is the part that runs the model and generates the result.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把请求发到我提供的 API 代理 Base URL，并用环境变量读取密钥。不要打印真实密钥；先检查代理地址、完整路由和代理授权，再发送无敏感内容的测试请求。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Send the request through the API proxy Base URL and read the key from an environment variable. Do not print the real key; check the proxy address, route, and authorization before a safe test request.

learning.assumes: You know that a client needs a network path to reach a model service.
learning.outcome: You can trace both directions of one model call and distinguish a public aggregation platform from an unknown relay service.

modules.title: How does an API proxy complete one model call?
Why can a relay create privacy risks?

items.title: Both the request and response pass through the relay
items.text: The prompt, context, file fragments, and any credential sent with the request may reach the relay first. The Provider's response also passes through the relay before reaching the tool.

items.title: Public information only makes a service easier to verify
items.text: A published operator, official documentation, and service terms make boundaries, billing, and privacy policies easier to inspect, but do not make a platform inherently trustworthy. If a third party handles the request, still verify retention, key handling, and the upstream service.

items.title: Unknown services carry greater risk
items.text: Some unofficial relays may assemble access through account pools or reverse proxies. If a service records requests, changes responses, or injects content, the AI tool usually cannot audit how that relay handles your data. Do not send keys, source code, or sensitive business data to an unknown relay.

modules.title: A relay is not the model Provider
modules.text: An API proxy usually receives, forwards, and returns data; that does not mean it trains or runs the model itself. A local VPN or network proxy may not understand API protocols. Changing the address changes the network path, but it does not automatically guarantee anonymity, security, result quality, or upstream availability.

distinctions.label: Model Provider
distinctions.text: A {c:provider} trains, hosts, and runs the actual language models; an {c:api-proxy} only forwards requests and responses along the network path.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: Send the request through the API proxy Base URL and read the key from an environment variable. Do not print the real key; check the proxy address, route, and authorization before a safe test request.
